title: {item:essentialcraft5:ember_forge}
summary: Forge embers and foci into a sword

blocks.text: Goal: build an Ember Forge and forge 4 embers and 4 elemental foci into an {item:essentialcraft5:forged_elemental_sword}.

items: The forge itself: {item:essentialcraft5:void_plating}, a {item:essentialcraft5:void_core} and a {item:essentialcraft5:void_mru_reactor} brought back from Hoanna, plus a {item:essentialcraft5:matter_of_eternity}. Recipe below.
4 embers, found in the chests of Hoanna's ruins ([[hoanna/relics]]).
4 elemental foci ([[essence/fuel_and_focus]]); each forging uses them up completely.

blocks.text: Lay a 5×5 floor of Void Stone and put the forge on the middle block. On the forge's layer, place a Void Stone in each corner and a Pale Plating two blocks away on each side; one layer up, place a Magic Plating in each corner, right on top of those four Void Stones.

items: Throw one ember onto each of the four Pale Platings and one focus onto each of the four Magic Platings. Whatever lands there is straightened out and held in place; passers-by and mobs can't pick it up.

items.text: Wait for night. {cfg:machines.ember_forge.ticks_required|sec} after all eight are in place, a sword pops out of the top of the forge.
{cfg:machines.ember_forge.ticks_required|sec} after all eight are in place, a sword pops out of the top of the forge.

items: What element the sword gets and what it does: see [[void_machines/ember_sword]].

blocks.title: Done when
blocks.text: Spell particles drift around the forge and a trail of red or blue sparks links each item to it; once forging starts, lava sparks rise from the top and a portal sound plays every so often.

items: Each forging takes only one item per spot: a whole stack of embers on one plating gives one at a time, and the rest goes into the next sword. Foci are eaten whole regardless of durability.

items.text: It only works at night: during the day nothing happens even with all eight in place. Places without a sky, like the Nether and the End, work any time, and a thunderstorm counts as night too.

items: A redstone signal pauses it and keeps the progress. If an item goes missing or the structure loses a block, progress starts over.
Right-click the forge with an empty hand to see what it's waiting for: which spot is missing, how many items are left, night, or the progress.
Sneak-right-click with an empty hand to release everything it's holding; it won't hold anything again for 10 seconds. Use this to take back items you put in the wrong place.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: The finished sword lands on top of the forge. At night, nearby mobs will happily pick up a sword lying on the ground, so light the area up and stay close until it's done.
The original research book describes it in a single line: "So shiny... So warm..."

title: {item:essentialcraft5:forged_elemental_sword}
summary: Foci set the element, ember pairs add the rest

blocks.text: Goal: forge an Ember Elemental Sword in the [[void_machines/ember_forge]]. Its damage and special effects depend entirely on the foci and embers that went in, and two swords from the same materials can still differ.

If one element appears more often among the four foci than each of the other three, it's the primary element; ties and one of each give "Combined". The primary element sets the base damage and an on-hit effect that costs <t>50</t> MRU per hit.

rows: Sets the target on fire for 5 s
Weakness and Slowness on the target for 2 s
Blindness and Mining Fatigue on the target for 2 s
Speed and Strength for you for 2.5 s

blocks.text: The secondary element is picked at random from the elements among the foci. It triggers when you press right-click and costs <t>50</t> MRU; at the same time the sword comes up to block like a shield.

rows: Fire Resistance for 2.5 s; hostile mobs within 2 blocks catch fire for 2 s (villagers, pets and other players don't)
Regeneration for 2.5 s; does nothing and costs nothing while you already have Regeneration

blocks.text: The 4 embers pair up by kind: four of the same kind make no pairs, four different kinds make 6. Each pair is looked up below. Damage bonuses add up pair by pair (up to <t>+36</t>); an effect given by several pairs only counts once.
If there are on-hit effects, each hit costs another <t>50</t> MRU and the effects last 3 s; damage bonuses alone cost nothing.

rows: Hurts the wielder, Hunger II on the target

items: Lightning: a bolt comes down on the target you hit, dealing 5 damage and setting it on fire for 8 s, and you get Fire Resistance II for 3 s. It only strikes that one target, doesn't set blocks on fire and doesn't turn villagers or pigs into anything; at most one strike every 2 seconds.
Hurts the wielder: you take 2 damage on every hit.
The strongest four are Acidic, Chaotic, Smouldering and Burning: their 6 pairs add up to +36 damage, at the price of hurting yourself.
No durability loss and enchantable; mining and blocking don't wear it down.

Holds 5000 MRU. Costs are taken from storage items you carry first, such as a {item:essentialcraft5:soul_shard} ([[storage/soul_storage]]), then from the sword itself; without enough MRU the effects stop but the damage still lands.
Blocking works like a shield: an axe hit can knock it down for 5 seconds.
The two copies in the creative inventory are unforged and have no attributes.

blocks.text: The original forge used up the items before reading their names, so the foci had already turned into air: every sword it made was "Combined / Combined" and no ember was ever recorded. Three typos in the effect table also kept all 7 Corrupted pairs from ever working. This table is working for the first time.
